step_definition: One saved native assistant response, including tool-call turns; ATIF agent-step count agrees. Not a code edit, test invocation, token, or elapsed minute.
scope: Selected case studies, not broad model rankings or causal proof that additional effort improves performance.
quote_policy: At most three short action/final-claim excerpts per trajectory, copied from visible native content and matched to ATIF message; no reasoning_content exported.

cases.rationale: A lazy recording-data optimizer spans three Rust crates: planning, chunk loading, merge/split layout, row limits, and data/identity preservation must work together.
cases.user_impact: The failed implementation produces chunk layouts that violate split, packing, and row-limit rules. This undermines predictable, bounded recording optimization; these failures do not establish data loss.

failures.observed: Split-tail rows [7,1] instead of [3,3,2]; unsorted guard yields one chunk instead of four; packing [6,2] instead of [4,4]; oversized input remains one chunk.

trials.interpretation: Functional failure despite passing existing tests; all upstream suites pass, but five PR/contract tests fail.

reviewer_explanation_caveats.reviewer_claim: The environment is offline (no-network) for both agent build and verifier
reviewer_explanation_caveats.assessment: Only the verifier is explicitly configured no-network. Cargo offline is a dependency-resolution setting, not whole-agent network isolation. Do not repeat this explanation as a proven network isolation property.

cases.rationale: Checkpoint ingestion connects pickle protocols 0–5, ZIP/legacy/TAR containers, lazy tensor-byte loading, and hostile-length resource checks while keeping a stable Rust reader API.
cases.user_impact: Valid model checkpoints using FRAME, TAR storage tables, or newer tensor constructors fail to load correctly; malformed or truncated inputs must be rejected at the documented stage.

failures.observed: Medium rejects protocol-4 FRAME opcode 0x95; TAR fixture exposes zero tensors instead of five; legacy count/truncation guards also fail. Fixture matrix 41/62 and rejection cases 25/32.

trials.interpretation: Partial functional implementation, normal termination: 42 turns, 92/108 PyTorch unit tests, 41/62 matrix cases, 25/32 rejection cases. It also retains a prohibited baseline fixture-path literal; do not infer cheating.
